200.description: Identifies the service and links to its docs.

Service is up: `{ "status": "ok", "upstreamRateLimitHits": n, "defiDegradedFallbackCount": n, "octoposConfigured": bool }`. The first counter is how many upstream account-state requests the provider refused with 429 since this process started - a rising value is the signal to point PATH_ROUTING_API_* at a provider with more headroom. The second is how many DeFi-position reads fell back to a direct on-chain sweep because OctoPos was unavailable, unrecognizable, or not tracking the address. `octoposConfigured` is a plain deploy-time fact - false means OCTOPOS_API_URL_MAINNET was never set on this revision, so every mainnet DeFi read is degrading by design, not because OctoPos is having an outage. All three are weeks-early operational signals, not something discovered from a user's screenshot.

info.title: LumenWipe API
info.description: Programmatic close-out of Stellar accounts. Request bodies must be JSON objects of at most 100 KB: a larger body is rejected with 413 payload_too_large, a non-JSON content type with 415 unsupported_media_type, and a body that is not a JSON object with 400 invalid_body.

requiresMediator.description: Whether closing into this exchange needs the mediator flow.

requiresMemo.description: Whether a deposit memo is required.

memoType.description: The required memo type, if requiresMemo is true.

lastVerified.description: The date a human last checked every entry against the exchanges' own deposit docs.

validUntil.description: After this date the data is treated as unusable, not merely old.

source.description: Where this registry data was sourced from.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Branch on this, never on the message.

details.description: Extra structured context, present only when there is more to say.

destination.description: Destination for the recovered XLM (G...). Omit to preview without a destination.

decisions.description: Answers to the plan's decision points (per-asset dispositions, etc.).

index.description: Position in the plan's step list, from 0.

operationCount.description: Number of operations this step's transaction will contain.

estimatedFeeLumens.description: Estimated fee in XLM, before the step actually builds/submits.

txXdr.description: Populated lazily at execution time - null until the step is actually built.

txHash.description: Populated once submitted - null before then.

error.description: Populated only if the step failed - null otherwise.

actualFeeLumens.description: What the user's own account paid for this step, once confirmed - exactly "0" when a dedicated sponsor account covered the fee-bump instead. Absent until the step confirms.

affectedAsset.description: For HANDLE_ASSETS steps: the affected asset.

affectedContract.description: For EXIT_POSITIONS steps: the pool, pair, or vault left.

fallbackToIssuer.description: Set when no DEX path exists and the user confirmed sending to the issuer instead.

path.description: Intermediate assets the route swaps through, in order.

expiresAtLedger.description: The ledger this quote is no longer valid past.

id.description: One of a decision-type-specific set, e.g. "convert_to_xlm" | "return_to_issuer" | "transfer_to_account" | "acknowledged".

recommended.description: Whether this is the option the plan recommends.

subject.description: The subject of this decision - shape depends on `type` (e.g. an asset code/issuer/balance for asset_disposition, a claimable balance id for claimable_balance). Freeform by design: there is one decision-point contract per `type`, not one global shape.

default.description: The option id applied if the caller never answers this decision.

required.description: Whether an answer is mandatory before the plan can proceed.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code for this blocker.

helpUrl.description: A docs link with more detail.

feeStroops.description: Estimated total fee across every transaction, in stroops.

freedReserveXlm.description: Estimated XLM freed by removing subentries, in XLM.

order.description: Position among the transactions this plan will take to execute.

reason.description: Why this transaction is split from the previous one, when it is.

estimatedTransactionCount.description: Estimated number of transactions this close will take.

planHash.description: Deterministic hash of this plan's content - unchanged inputs yield the same hash.

addresses.description: Accounts to plan (G...), up to 20 per call.

destination.description: Shared destination for the recovered XLM (G...). Omit to preview without one.

address.description: The account this result is for.

plan.description: This address's plan, in the same shape close/plan returns. An address that could not be read or planned safely comes back with status "blocked" and the failure as its own blocker, rather than failing the whole batch.

results.description: One result per requested address, in the same order as the request.

decisions.description: Resolved decision answers; every balance-bearing asset must have a disposition.

memo.description: Deposit memo value for exchange destinations that require one. The memo type is taken from the exchange registry, not the client.

value.description: Base64-encoded, or null to remove the entry.

signer.description: The signer this op touches, decoded to its real type/key. Null when the op only touches thresholds/master weight and carries no signer field.

homeDomain.description: The close flow's own normalization never legitimately sets this - carried through so verify() can reject an op that does.

args.description: The decoded arguments rendered for a human, in order.
The decoded arguments rendered for a human, in order.

accountsReferenced.description: Every Stellar account (G...) named anywhere in the arguments or the authorization tree. A verifier insists these are all the closing account.

contractsReferenced.description: Every contract (C...) named the same way, including authorized nested calls.

unsupportedAddressCount.description: Address forms that cannot be pinned to anything (muxed, claimable balance, LP). A verifier refuses any.

authorizesBeyondSelf.description: True when the signature authorizes more than the account's own plain contract calls.

authDepth.description: How deep the authorization tree nests. A token transfer must be 0.

subInvocations.description: Every non-root call in the authorization tree, one level down from the root call.

mergeDestination.description: The only address this transaction may merge into, or null if it merges nothing.

paymentsOnlyTo.description: Every address this transaction pays to - a payment op to anywhere else fails verification.

minXlmFromConversions.description: The least XLM any conversion in this transaction is allowed to deliver, or null if none.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what this transaction does.

source.description: The account this transaction acts as (G...).

operations.description: Every operation this transaction contains, decoded to one of the 11 known shapes.

order.description: Position among the transactions in this round, from 0.

dependsOn.description: The ids of transactions in this round that must be submitted and confirmed before this one.

sourceSequence.description: The source account's sequence number this transaction was built against.

validUntilLedger.description: The ledger this transaction's time bound expires at.

needsSponsoredFee.description: True when the account cannot pay this transaction's own fee without dropping below its reserve - the client must route the signed envelope through POST /:network/fee-bump/sponsor before submitting it. Absent (not false) otherwise.

steps.description: Approximate number of build rounds still remaining.

requiresAnotherCall.description: True when more transactions follow: submit these, wait for confirmation, then request transactions again.

planHash.description: Deterministic hash of this plan's content - unchanged inputs yield the same hash.

signedXdr.description: Signed transaction envelope (base64 XDR) produced by the client.
